parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. Opening Prayer O God, who in Thine inscrutable providence didst call Saint Sophia to offer upon the altar of faith not only her own life but the lives of her three beloved daughters, Faith, Hope, and Charity, grant that through her powerful intercession we may receive the graces we seek in this novena, especially

and that, following her example of holy fortitude, we may cling to Thee above all earthly things. Through Christ our Lord. Amen. In Honor of Sophia’s Steadfast Faith Saint Sophia, noble mother who carried the names of the three theological virtues in your very children, you stood unmoved before the throne of the emperor Hadrian and refused to deny the Lord Jesus Christ. Teach us to confess our faith openly, without shame or compromise, in the small trials of daily life as well as in times of great testing. Closing Prayer of the Novena O glorious Saint Sophia, noble among the martyrs and blessed among mothers, thou who didst lay down the dearest treasure of thy heart for the love of God, look with mercy upon us thy poor petitioners. We do not ask to be spared from trials; thou art not the patron of those who flee the Cross. But we ask for the grace to endure them as thou didst: with faith unshaken, hope undimmed, and love unconsumed. Carry our prayers before the throne of the Most High, and obtain for us what is truly for our good and for our eternal salvation. And when at last our days are spent, may we come to that same tomb where thou didst die in prayer and rise into glory, the company of God, and of thee, and of all the saints forever. Through Christ our Lord. Amen. Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen. Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Saint Sophia of Rome, pray for us! In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
